transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom, my name is Lucy. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Lucy, I'm calling because my latest bill is way higher than it should be. I'm really frustrated with these constant overcharges.
Agent: I am sorry to hear that you are experiencing issues with your billing. I can certainly look into this for you. Before we proceed, could you please provide your account number?
Customer: Sure, it is 10240379. My name is Aisha Khan.
Agent: Thank you, Ms. Khan. I see your account for the address 150 Station Road. I understand how upsetting it is to see an unexpected charge on your statement.
Customer: It is. I've been a customer for years and this is the third time this has happened. My phone number is 98870 94397.
Agent: I can check if a credit is possible for the overcharge. Please be aware that any refund or credit is subject to approval and typically takes 7-10 business days to process.
Customer: Wait, why is it subject to approval? I was overcharged! I want my money back now, not in ten days.
Agent: I understand your frustration, but this is the standard procedure for all billing adjustments.
Customer: This is ridiculous. I am tired of dealing with this every few months. I'm just going to cancel my service and switch to another provider.
Agent: I would hate to see you leave. Let me see if I can find a better plan for you.
Customer: I don't want a new plan, I want my money back and a guarantee that this won't happen again!
Agent: I cannot guarantee that billing errors will not occur in the future, but I will submit a request for the credit.
